title: Standard Practices — Structures — Introduction of the Cold Expanded Fastener Hole Standard
abstract: An information bulletin that makes the cold expanded fastener hole standard available to operators, with the qualification requirements, the applicability limits and the training that must be in place before it is used.

sections.planning_reason: Rework of a fastener hole after a crack finding has been done by reaming to the next oversize since entry into service. That restores static strength but returns the hole to the fatigue quality it started with, which is why a blended finding at a high-cycle location tends to return within four years. Cold expansion is well established in the industry and improves the detail rather than restoring it, but the programme had no declared standard, so every application went through a bespoke substantiation that most operators would not attempt.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin does not modify the aircraft. It introduces the cold expanded fastener hole standard as a declared standard practice for pressurised shell structure, gives the applicable diameter range of 4.8 mm to 9.5 mm, the minimum edge distance, the maximum number of expansions permitted on one hole and the inspection required afterwards, and states that an expanded hole may not subsequently be reamed oversize. It identifies the interference fit fastener and the sealing washer to be used where the hole passes through the pressure boundary, and releases the coupon set used for operator qualification.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Read the standard practice in full before any application. Obtain the mandrel and split sleeve set for the diameter range to be worked. Qualify at least one operator per shift against the coupon set, using the plate, clip and splice plate released with this bulletin, and retain the coupons and the records. Confirm that the location to be reworked is within the declared applicability: the diameter range, the edge distance and the structure type all have to be checked, and a hole that has already been reamed oversize is outside the standard. Do the expansion in accordance with the standard practice and the referenced task, AMM-T-51-10-11-300-001-A. Install the interference fit fastener and, at a pressure boundary, the sealing washer. Do the post-expansion inspection. Record the application in the aircraft structural repair record; this is required, because the inspection interval that may later be claimed depends on it.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all TITAN-88 aircraft. There is nothing to embody: the standard applies the next time a covered hole is reworked. Operators without the mandrel set and a qualified operator may not use it and continue to the ream-and-oversize practice.
sections.material_note: No kit. The coupon set is orderable as a training aid and is not consumed on the aircraft. The interference fit fastener and the sealing washer are ordered against the individual application. The mandrel set is a tooling item available from the regional pool.

type_data.compliance_time: Not applicable. The standard applies at the next rework of a covered fastener hole.
